title: Will Kenrith | Planeswalker
description: Read Rowan and Will Kenrith's biography: two mysterious twin planeswalkers that reinforce each other's powers in battle.

paragraphs.text: Will Kenrith and his sister Rowan are unique in the Multiverse, the only Planeswalkers known to share a Spark. Wherever one goes, the other must follow. He is an accomplished cryomancer who uses ice magic to control the battlefield and protect his allies. Compassionate and curious, Will seeks to understand the truth in all things, believing that knowledge is the best path to wisdom.
